task_title: Shared RunStats collector and run bundles

plan_review.summary: Keep world harvesters above shared; use shared generic bundle/assembly seam, optional toJsonl on shared recorder, cursor-based bounded logs, and emit once at terminal presentation before reload/restart. Alternatives rejected: importing game into shared/engine and changing runHeadless return type.

findings.detail: The quit end reason is plumbed but is guarded after the current terminal screens have already emitted their bundle; it becomes active when an active-run quit screen exists.
The production recorder accumulates per-run event data; a later telemetry PR should bound or persist that recorder payload if very long runs are supported.
The scene-level emitRunBundle integration is not directly tested, although ring-buffer and bundle contract behavior are covered.

independent_grade.notes: The diff is layer-clean and preserves deterministic headless RunStats behavior. Shared contracts remain game-agnostic, human harvesting stays in src/game/ai, and MainGameScene receives the seam through injected factories. Typecheck, targeted tests, fast verification, and focused fingerprint comparison pass.
